title: N-to-2^N Decoder
constraints: Parameter `N` (default 3): `sel` is N bits wide and `y` is 2ᴺ bits wide. The judge uses **N = 5** (32 outputs).
`y` is one-hot with bit `sel` set when `en = 1`, and all zeros when `en = 0`.
hints: `y = en ? (1 << sel) : 0`, with a constant 1 that is 2ᴺ bits wide.
Width expressions: `[(1<<N)-1:0]` in Verilog, `2**N - 1 downto 0` in VHDL.
A loop `y[i] = en && (sel == i)` over all 2ᴺ outputs works too.
